ACT I OF 2020
ACT I OF 2020
AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act to amend the Agricultural Produce
Markets Act, 1939
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
15th January, 2020]
NO. PAS
/ LEGIS-B-14/2019, dated 15.1.2020.---
The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 04th December, 2019 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 07th January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the
Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.
